    Counting indecomposables of a subcategory of the linear quiver #

    The number |ind C| of isomorphism classes of indecomposable objects of a subcategory C of mod Λ_n (Statement.indCard) is the number of intervals [a, d] with M_{a,d} ∈ C (indCard_eq), and the statistic ρ_n(C) of Definition 7.1 (Statement.rho) is the number of intervals [a, n] in C (rho_eq). Both are proved by an explicit bijection between the isomorphism classes of indecomposables of C and the intervals of C, using the classification of indecomposables.
